onet_tasks: Test drive vehicles and test components and systems, using equipment such as infrared engine analyzers.
Repair or replace parts such as pistons, rods, gears, valves, and bearings.
Confer with customers to obtain descriptions of vehicle problems.
Install equipment such as navigation, radar, and communication systems.
Inspect and test electronic equipment to locate causes of malfunction.

values.plain_language: Installs and services phones, routers and IT equipment
onet_tasks: Install telecommunications equipment in residences or businesses.
Test repaired, newly installed, or updated equipment to ensure that it functions properly.
Write supporting code for web applications or websites.
Design, build, or maintain websites using authoring or scripting languages.
Identify problems uncovered by testing or customer feedback, and correct problems.

values.plain_language: Writes software for computers and phones
onet_tasks: Analyze user needs and software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints.
Develop and direct software system testing and validation procedures, programming, and documentation.

values.plain_language: Helps people solve computer and software problems
onet_tasks: Answer user inquiries regarding computer software or hardware operation to resolve problems.
Set up equipment for employee use, performing or ensuring proper installation of cables, operating systems, or appropriate software.

values.plain_language: Sells goods in a shop and helps customers
onet_tasks: Greet customers and ascertain what each customer wants or needs.
Compute sales prices, total purchases, and receive and process cash or credit payment.
Sew garments using a sewing machine or by hand.
Measure parts such as sleeves or pant legs, and mark or pin-fold alterations.

values.plain_language: Builds and fits wooden structures and furniture
onet_tasks: Measure and mark cutting lines on materials, using a ruler, pencil, chalk, and marking gauge.
Assemble and fasten materials to make frameworks or props, using hand tools and wood screws.

values.plain_language: Installs and repairs water pipes and fittings
onet_tasks: Assemble pipe sections, tubing, or fittings, using couplings, clamps, screws, bolts, cement, plastic solvent, caulking, or soldering, brazing, or welding equipment.
Review blueprints, building codes, or specifications to determine work details or procedures.
Operate safety equipment and use safe work habits.
Weld components in flat, vertical, or overhead positions.

values.plain_language: Drives passengers or goods for a living
onet_tasks: Follow safe driving practices and traffic laws.
Transport passengers or goods to specified destinations.

values.plain_language: Prepares food in homes, restaurants or stalls
onet_tasks: Season and cook food according to recipes.
Wash, peel, cut, and seed fruits and vegetables to prepare them for consumption.

values.plain_language: Handles paperwork, records and office tasks
onet_tasks: Operate office machines, such as photocopiers and scanners, facsimile machines, voice mail systems, and personal computers.
Answer telephones, direct calls, and take messages.

values.plain_language: Answers calls and handles customer questions
onet_tasks: Confer with customers by telephone or in person to provide information about products or services.
Keep records of customer interactions or transactions.

values.plain_language: Cleans homes and helps with household chores
onet_tasks: Clean rooms, hallways, lobbies, lounges, restrooms, corridors, elevators, stairways.
Harvest fruits and vegetables by hand.
Operate tractors, tractor-drawn machinery, and self-propelled machinery to plow, cultivate, or harvest crops.
